+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TextIO
+
+from _pytest._io import TerminalWriter
+from _pytest.config import Config
+from _pytest.config import create_terminal_writer
+
+
+def plain_auto_highlight(config: Config, file: TextIO | None = None) -> TerminalWriter:
+    """Create a terminal writer for machine logs, with highlighting off in auto mode."""
+    writer = create_terminal_writer(config, file)
+    if config.option.code_highlight == "auto":
+        writer.code_highlight = False
+    return writer

+    config = pytester.parseconfig("--color=yes")
